lines: After leaving the black market district and passing through some ruins, the mechanical spiders arrived at an abandoned tunnel.
This place looks kind of familiar.
That sounds right, it was on a previous mission. Being chased by that big robot.
Yeah, that time as well, we were here on the masked lady's request...
Well, I suppose these abandoned passages are fitting pathways for people operating underground.
A web of tunnels not only spread throughout every part of Tokyo Kingdom, but also led to the mainland through the seafloor.
It looks like the target came through here and then headed for that tunnel over there. Only about half an hour ago.
That way... That's the direction of the mainland...
In my mind I tried to recall a map of the area. Presumably Gaiza had already assassinated the Dragon Gate executives and was planning to escape Tokyo Kingdom.
Suddenly, Shikanosuke jumped on me and pushed me to the ground.
And in the spot where I had been standingー
Tsk! They know we're here!! Surround them!! Don't let the Fuma ninja escape!!
It appeared to be some kind of UFS organization. They must have had followed Gaiza and arrived at this tunnel.
F-Fuma ninja!? Are they after us!?
I think they got the wrong people. Or should I say "the wrong Fuma?"
Yeah, I'm sure the "Fuma ninja" they're referring to are Gaiza and his men.
Though even if you tell them, they won't believe you.
You're right. We have no choice, let's do this everyone!!
We turned toward the voices of the UFS soldiers.
I wonder if they'll put up more of a fight than the Zombies.
